name: Fafa and Ancient Alphabet
description: Ancient Egyptians are known to have used a large set of symbols to write on the walls of the temples. Fafa and Fifa went to one of the temples and found two non-empty words S 1 and S 2 of equal lengths on the wall of temple written one below the other. Since this temple is very ancient, some symbols from the words were erased. The symbols in the set have equal probability for being in the position of any erased symbol.
